name: Rechenzentrum TU Clausthal
notes: University computing center in Clausthal-Zellerfeld (Landkreis Goslar); official RZ page identifies it as central IT service provider for research, teaching and administration incl. AI services and cloud. No MW capacity disclosed.

name: PingBASE Rechenzentren Goslar
notes: Small local provider listing 'PingBASE Rechenzentren' at Osterwiecker Str. 46A, 38690 Goslar; limited public technical detail, no capacity disclosed.

name: TKRZ Nordhorn data center
notes: TKRZ states it offers storage/server services in its data centers in Emsdetten, Greven, Rheine and Nordhorn; colocation page references a Watergreen certificate for the Nordhorn site. No MW capacity disclosed.

name: GWDG joint data center Göttingen Nordcampus
developer: GWDG / University of Göttingen / UMG / Max Planck Society
notes: Sustainable high-performance data center on Göttingen North Campus, handed over to GWDG and partners on 2021-06-30; serves university, university medicine and Max Planck institutes. No MW capacity disclosed.

name: Avacon/enviaM Data Center Sehnde (Region Hannover)
developer: Avacon Connect GmbH / envia TEL GmbH
notes: High-performance colocation data center in Gewerbegebiet Sehnde-Ost, Region Hannover; spatenstich 2024, Richtfest 2025, commissioned early 2026 per envia TEL/eco; 2,000 sqm, space for about 28,000 servers, waste-heat concept. Do not confuse with Telis Mehrum campus (in Hohenhameln, Landkreis Peine - see batch-099).

name: kyberio Hannover data centers
notes: Operator states it runs two autonomous data centers in Hannover at Am Eisenwerk and Am Mittelfelde, plus a Frankfurt PoP; about 28,000 sq ft technical footprint, redundant infrastructure, ISO 27001 based on BSI IT-Grundschutz. No MW disclosed.

name: nLighten Hanover HAJ1
notes: Edge data center near the A2 and Hannover Airport; official location page lists more than 863 sqm and 1,800 kW of power; Baxtel lists it as the largest Lower Saxony facility by known power.

name: GRASS-MERKUR Rechenzentrum Hannover
notes: Hannover colocation/cloud operator since 1971, ISO 27001 certified; found via vendor search. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Rechenzentrum Seevetal / Maschen
developer: REVITALIS Vierunddreissigste Grundstücksgesellschaft mbH / Revitalis Development GmbH
notes: Revitalis plans a data center in Maschen/Seevetal on a brownfield south of Winsener Strasse (K10) between A39 and the K10; local reporting 2025-06 and project website say the concept is being revised after public discussions; secondary real-estate reporting cites about 60 MW.

name: Büddenstedt West data center area (KI-Rechenzentrum und Solarpark)
developer: Undisclosed project developers / Stadt Helmstedt planning process
notes: City of Helmstedt council document (Bebauungsplan/Sondergebiet Rechenzentrum Büddenstedt West): three developers proposed wind/PV plus two data centers; final-stage total facility power cited around 170 MW, zoning changes required. news38 (2026-05-24) reports local opposition to the AI data center and solar park project.

name: EVI Rechenzentrum im Gefahrenabwehrzentrum Hildesheim
developer: EVI Energieversorgung Hildesheim / Stadt Hildesheim / Depenbrock Partnering
notes: New Gefahrenabwehrzentrum (GAZ) in Hildesheim includes an EVI-operated data center; contract signed 2025-03-11, spatenstich 2025-09-22, completion planned March 2028; data center component about EUR 6m; no MW capacity disclosed.

name: Landkreis Lüneburg Kreisverwaltung server room / Rechenzentrum
notes: DataCenter-Insider case study describes a new highly available, energy-efficient server room for the Lüneburg district administration; small institutional facility, no MW capacity disclosed.

name: EWE Rechenzentrum OL1
notes: Colocation facility at Tirpitzstrasse 39, 26122 Oldenburg; EWE business colocation page confirms EWE operates high-availability data centers in Oldenburg and Osnabrück on 100% green power with ISO/IEC 27001. No MW disclosed.

name: EWE Rechenzentrum OL2
notes: Second EWE TEL Oldenburg facility at Cloppenburger Strasse 310, 26133 Oldenburg per Data Center Map; EWE colocation page confirms Oldenburg data center operations. No MW disclosed.

name: KDO Hochleistungsrechenzentrum Oldenburg
notes: KDO official pages state municipal applications, hosting, network services and storage are operated in its ISO-certified high-performance Oldenburg data center. No MW capacity disclosed.

name: CEWE Oldenburg Rechenzentrum
notes: CEWE data center in operation since 2012 with Blue Angel energy-efficiency award, replacing older server rooms and reducing CO2 by about 130 t/year. No MW disclosed.

name: Ankum Sondergebiet Rechenzentrum am Lordsee / HANSALOG-HDS
developer: HANSALOG GmbH & Co. KG / HDS-Rechenzentrum GmbH
notes: B-Plan Nr. 66 with parallel FNP amendment creates a Sondergebiet (special area) for a data center at Am Lordsee 1, Ankum, Landkreis Osnabrück, on the HANSALOG/HDS site; about 1.8 ha, prior demolition in 2021. Land-use planning stage; no MW disclosed.

name: Stadt Bramsche Neubau Rechenzentrum
notes: VOB/A awarded contract 'Stadt Bramsche, Neubau Rechenzentrum' published 2026-06-22 via Vergabe Niedersachsen; scope and capacity not disclosed in public summary.

name: LückerServices Cloud-Rechenzentrum Georgsmarienhütte
notes: District IT service provider advertises a CLOUD-Rechenzentrum among core services; small/private operating facility, no public technical details or capacity.
